Aurorus

Rock Ice

Kalos · Generation 6

Aurorus is a Rock/Ice-type Tundra Pokémon first found in Kalos (Generation 6). It stands 2.7 m tall and weighs 225 kg. It evolves from Amaura. Its highest base stat is HP (123), with a base stat total of 521.
